title: Apply a credit to an open invoice
body:
Billing needs to knock a credit off an invoice that has not been paid yet.

Add `apply_credit(invoice_id, amount)` to `parcelo/invoices.py`. It reduces the amount of an open invoice by the credit and returns the remaining amount. The invoice's amount must still work with the existing reports and the customer balance after a credit is applied.

Applying a credit to an invoice that does not exist must fail. So must applying one to an invoice that is not open, or a credit larger than the invoice's amount.
